name: JSON values read without a text round trip

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: wasm/web with headed Playwright and WebGPU enabled
hypothesisMarkdown:
## JSON values read without a text round trip Hypothesis

An app's import of a compiled scene or a Lottie file reaches the player as a JSON value (`Source::Json`), which was written back to text and parsed again. A compiled scene is now deserialized from the value (`compiled::from_value`, the same checks in the same order), a Lottie document converted from a copy of it (`dxn_vector_animation_lottie::read_value`); other values are refused as their text was.\n\n**Tested mechanism:** reading values directly. **Allowed:** core `compiled.rs`, lottie `lib.rs`, nsh `source::read_json`, a test group, docs. **Forbidden:** the converters.

Release bench over the 53 corpus files (median of 3 runs, best of 5 each), plus the focused tests of the touched area.
